generate_maze_trace_dataset: generate a maze trace dataset by running A* search with specified width, height, and deterministic flag
tokenize_maze_trace_dataset: tokenize a previously generated maze execution trace dataset into a token sequence dataset for training
evaluate_rollout: evaluate a rollout batch to check if token sequences contain correct or optimal maze plans
reduce_rollout_to_shortest_trace: map a rollout dataset to a shorter token sequence dataset by extracting shortest optimal plans
create_maze_spec: create a maze specification with width, height, start position, goal position, and wall positions
